summary_markdown:
A process was discussed for updating translations within a system using `mops`. This requires setting an environment variable (`export TOLGEE_[redacted]`) so that running `npm run translations` pulls the latest translations from a specific service. While this feature is not strictly necessary, it is useful for someone who frequently adds new keys.

The process involves a simple GET request to synchronize data in one direction.
It was confirmed that the setup works on Windows, addressing compatibility issues with previous Linux-only scripts.
decisions: The system requires setting an environment variable (`export TOLGEE_[redacted]`) for translation updates.
